title: Combos in Street Fighter II started as a bug.

instagram.caption:
Combos in Street Fighter II started as a bug.

While testing, producer Noritaka Funamizu noticed you could land a second hit before the opponent had recovered from the first. The timing was so hard that the team just left it in.

Players found it anyway and mastered it. Today every fighting game is built around combos, chains of hits the opponent can't escape.

Who was your main?
